data.name: Pradyumn
data.gender_notes: Pradyumn is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pradyumn is derived from the Sanskrit word pradīpta, which means 'shining forth'. This name is associated with the sun and represents the light of knowledge and wisdom. The name Pradyumn carries the meaning “Sun, Light, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pradyumn usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pradyumn is a spiritual name that symbolizes the inner light of knowledge and wisdom. It is believed to bring enlightenment and a deeper understanding of the universe.
data.etymology: Pradyumn belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Light, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pradyumn total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered a powerful symbol of life, energy, and creativity. The name Pradyumn embodies the brightness, power, and illumination associated with the sun.

The name is a reminder to seek the inner light and guidance that comes from within, just like the sun provides light to the world.

historical_references.reference: Pradyumna is the eldest son of Krishna and Rukmini. He is the grandson of Vasudeva and Devaki, and is named after the god Pradyumna, who was an incarnation of Vishnu.
Another Pradyumna, a king of the Sunga Dynasty (2nd century BCE), is believed to have ruled over Magadha. He succeeded his father Agnimitra and was succeeded by his son Vasumitra.
